ground_truth_role: source text labels and source lineage; they are rendering inputs and verification anchors, not the regression target
history_evidence: `git rev-list --all --objects | grep ground_truth.csv` returns no match; the file never entered the object database
recorded_hash_enforcement_note: verify_outputs re-derives ground-truth content from the frozen plan and rejects missing, altered, lineage-inconsistent or extra rows, but it does not re-hash the file against run_metadata.dataset.ground_truth_sha256. A semantics-preserving row reordering is therefore accepted while the recorded byte hash becomes stale. This does not change any label; it is a byte-integrity gap, not a benchmark-validity gap.
regression_target: ssim_target in manifest.csv, computed between each authorised corrupted image and its source-specific clean reference
